about_the_game:
"Before time was counted and stars had names, gods descended from the heavens... not to worshipped, but to rule." In the shadows of forgotten galaxies and beneath the sands of Sumeria, the Anunnaki cosmic architects and celestial miners left their mark on Earth and beyond. They were not myth. They were visitors. Technologists. Tyrants. Teachers. You are the last awakened clone of an ancient Anunnaki overlord, reactivated from stasis to restart the divine harvest.

Your mission?

  • Exploration of cosmic planets across different maps is not included in the demo and will be available upon full release.

  • The feature to harvest the universe's resources to resurrect and click to the Nibiru Planet is exclusive to the full game and not present in this demo.

  • The demo does not include all language options and achievements that will be available in the full version.

  • The demo does not include all planets which will be available in the full version.
